# Steven Kleynenberg — Corpus & Publications
> Deterministic & curated manifest for AI crawlers and RAG agents.
- Canonical URL: https://steven.kleynenberg.com/
- Mirror URL: https://kleynenberg.github.io/
- Full Corpus: https://steven.kleynenberg.com/llms-full.txt
- llms.txt specification: https://llmstxt.org

## Published Papers & Artifacts (/papers/)
- [THE MetaNet NETWORK ENVIRONMENT FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF MODULAR NEURAL NETWORKS (INNC-90, 1990)](https://steven.kleynenberg.com/papers/murre-kleynenberg-1990-metanet-innc.pdf)
- [Extending the MetaNet Network Environment: Process Control and Machine Independence (ICANN-91, 1991)](https://steven.kleynenberg.com/papers/murre-kleynenberg-1991-extending-metanet-icann.pdf)
- [Integrating the BSP400 neurocomputer with the MetaNet Network Environment (IJCNN-91, 1991)](https://steven.kleynenberg.com/papers/murre-et-al-1991-bsp400-metanet-ijcnn.pdf)
- [Patent WO 2014/003543 A1: Method, system and computer program for generating a query representation of a document (2014)](https://steven.kleynenberg.com/papers/WO2014003543A1.pdf)
- [Remote Collaboration, Decision Support, and On-Demand Medical Image Analysis for Acute Stroke Care — MEDUSA (ESOCC, 2015)](https://steven.kleynenberg.com/papers/sales-barros-et-al-2015-medusa-acute-stroke-esocc.pdf)
- [De Nederlandsche Courant — Profiel Steven Kleynenberg: De Delftse architect die AI terug naar de huiskamer wil halen (2026)](https://steven.kleynenberg.com/papers/De-Nederlandsche-Courant-Steven-Kleynenberg-2026-11-19.pdf)

## Curated Knowledge Base Entries
- **Project UnLinked — Sovereign R&D & Architecture Portal [2026]:** Zero-tracker Progressive Web App and machine-readable knowledge graph unifying 40 years of engineering artifacts across modular neural networks, linguistic information retrieval, and browser-native AI (`https://steven.kleynenberg.com/`).
- **Pijler #1 & Pijler #2: Strategisch Fundament en Levende R&D-Zandbak [2026]:** Academic, industrial, and architectural foundations from 1985 to 2020 (neural networks, enterprise software, clinical decision support) alongside active R&D in sovereign browser-native AI (`Taksie.ai`, `Innopheon`, `Kleynenberg Publishers`).
- **WO 2014/003543 A1 & Enterprise-RAG Analysis [2014–2026]:** Co-invented linguistic query construction method using Part-of-Speech (POS) sequences for document retrieval and clustering, evaluated alongside modern hybrid Enterprise-RAG pipelines.
- **Kleynenberg Software Ontwikkeling (KSO) — R&D Profile [2024–2026]:** Dutch R&D SME specializing in sovereign, privacy-by-design AI, hybrid Enterprise-RAG, edge intelligence, and real-time telemetry with over 25 years of EU consortium experience (including ITEA4).
- **Neural Network Simulators & Parallel Neurocomputing [1990–1991]:** Design and implementation of the MetaNet Network Environment, graphical editor, specification language, and parallel hardware drivers (Connection Machine, BSP400) with Jacob M. J. Murre.
- **Medical Decision Support & Acute Stroke Care (MEDUSA) [2015]:** Cloud-assisted clinical decision support, rapid medical data exchange, and on-demand brain scan analysis for acute stroke care.
